get.description: Owned by the API host. Public; no identity, permission or organization/site scope required. No inputs: nonempty query strings and request bodies are rejected. JSON/form parsing is capped at 102400 bytes; compressed bodies are unsupported. Does not check database readiness or business access.

400.description: Malformed input, query parameters or body supplied to this no-input operation.

413.description: JSON/form parser byte or parameter limit exceeded.

500.description: Unexpected host failure; no internal details are exposed.

200.description: Authorized original private PNG; never included in the public bundle.

info.title: IOP local API host
info.description: Health plus explicitly activated local analytical POC. Business operations require a configured local demo session, current site permissions and exact configured scope; no shared-user authentication claim.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into the documented request representation; empty means the whole request.

importId.description: Attempt identity for explicit outcome recovery.

traceId.description: Server-generated error occurrence identifier; not a client-supplied ID.

errors.description: Only present for explicit safe input validation failures (400).

endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint without credentials, query or fragment.

credentialReference.description: Logical reference only; never a secret value.

dueDate.description: Optional site calendar date, or empty string.

implementedDate.description: Required for implemented/evaluated; site calendar date.

elevation.description: Unknown until surveyed; normalized elevation, never metric height.

recordId.description: Explicit current formal record selection; empty means no record selected.

history.description: Explicit historical search; disables the default closed-work week window.

doneFrom.description: Completion calendar date lower bound; unfinished work remains visible.

doneTo.description: Completion calendar date upper bound; unfinished work remains visible.

reason.description: Required reason for exclusion from the repair scope.

dueDate.description: Optional calendar due date, or empty string.

assignedAt.description: Last true person-assignment instant; unrelated edits do not change it.

completedAt.description: Last completion instant; empty while unfinished.

statusCounts.description: Counts under all filters except the selected status.

reason.description: Required explanation for edits and reopening.

before.description: Exclusive revision boundary; zero starts at latest.

assignedAt.description: Last true person-assignment instant; unrelated edits do not change it.

completedAt.description: Last completion instant; empty while unfinished.

after.description: Assignment-event checkpoint only; current work is always returned.

namespace.description: Exact source namespace; site-equipment for handover, analytics for analytical rows.

sourceId.description: Required for analytics; empty for site-equipment.

validationNote.description: Required evidence when validating a manually registered asset.

locationDetails.description: Manual location/group details within the configured area; not physical validation.

key.description: Idempotency key for a new asset; empty for edits.

locationId.description: Configured location and descendants; empty includes the exact site catalog.

kind.description: Filter the source before totals and pagination; omit to include all authorized sources.

from.description: Inclusive site-local recording date; at most 366 days.

recordedAt.description: Exact server recording instant for operational revisions. Empty for date-only analytical aggregates.

seconds.description: Accumulated alarm seconds, never plant downtime.

total.description: Full matching count across currently authorized and available sources.

userId.description: Explicit target user for an email; CSV has userId per row.

filters.description: Exact per-column values combined with AND; minutes match displayed two-decimal values.

months.description: Complete calendar months (YYYY-MM) included within the reporting range.

toExclusive.description: Exclusive reporting-date label. Maximum range: 366 days.
Exclusive reporting-date label. Maximum range: 366 days.

departmentMatrix.description: Operational matrix: pending carry-forward categories and unresolved daily categories published today in the site time zone.

notificationsAfter.description: Colleague publications and revisions mentioning/assigning the caller after this UTC instant; ordered by notification time independently of entry date.

responsibleId.description: Omit for all assignees; empty string selects unassigned entries.
